q:
22 सितंबर 2026 को प्रदान किए गए दादासाहेब फाल्के पुरस्कार के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: 72वें राष्ट्रीय फिल्म पुरस्कारों में दिग्गज अभिनेता अनंत नाग को वर्ष 2024 के लिए दादासाहेब फाल्के पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया।
कथन II: यह समारोह गुजरात के एकता नगर में आयोजित किया गया था।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: न तो I और न ही II
e: Both statements are correct. Anant Nag received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award (for 2024) at the 72nd National Film Awards held on 22 September 2026 at Ekta Nagar, Gujarat. Exam Boosters: (1) The award comprises a Swarna Kamal (Golden Lotus) medallion, a shawl, and a cash prize of ₹10 lakh. (2) It is presented annually by the Directorate of Film Festivals (Ministry of Information & Broadcasting).
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Dadasaheb Phalke Award conferred on 22 September 2026:
Statement I: Veteran actor Anant Nag was honoured with the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024 at the 72nd National Film Awards.
Statement II: The ceremony was hosted at Ekta Nagar in Gujarat.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: नवतेज सरना ने अंग्रेजी भाषा श्रेणी में साहित्य अकादमी पुरस्कार 2025 किस पुस्तक के लिए जीता?
e: Navtej Sarna won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in English for his historical novel "Crimson Spring". Exam Boosters: (1) Sahitya Akademi was founded on 12 March 1954 (headquartered at Rabindra Bhavan, New Delhi). (2) The award carries a copper plaque (designed by Satyajit Ray) and ₹1 lakh cash prize.
qe: For which book did Navtej Sarna win the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in the English language category?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में जवाहर द्वीप ने कौन-सा अनूठा पर्यावरणीय कीर्तिमान स्थापित किया?
o: भारत का पहला सौर-संचालित हवाई अड्डा
भारत का पहला ज्वारीय विद्युत केंद्र
भारत का पहला कार्बन-तटस्थ इस्पात संयंत्र
भारत का पहला प्लास्टिक-मुक्त तेल टर्मिनल
e: In October 2026, Jawahar Dweep (near Mumbai) became India's first Plastic-Free Oil Terminal by eliminating single-use plastics across its marine terminal operations. Exam Boosters: (1) India's Sagarmala Programme promotes port-led sustainable development and coastal green logistics.
qe: What unique environmental milestone was achieved by Jawahar Dweep in October 2026?
oe: First tidal power station in India
First carbon-neutral steel plant in India
First Plastic-Free Oil Terminal in India

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में पश्चिम बंगाल के किस टाइगर रिज़र्व में बाघ पुनर्वास कार्यक्रम (Tiger Reintroduction Program) प्रारंभ किया गया?
e: The Tiger Reintroduction Program was launched in Buxa Tiger Reserve (Alipurduar, West Bengal) in October 2026 to rebuild its resident tiger population. Exam Boosters: (1) National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) is a statutory body under the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972 (amended 2006). (2) International Tiger Day is observed on 29 July.
qe: In October 2026, a Tiger Reintroduction Program was officially launched in which tiger reserve of West Bengal?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में भारत और फ्रांस ने किस सांस्कृतिक विरासत क्षेत्र पर केंद्रित एक द्विपक्षीय समझौता ज्ञापन (MoU) पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
e: India and France signed a bilateral MoU in October 2026 for cooperation in Manuscript Conservation, scientific preservation, and archival digitization. Exam Boosters: (1) UNESCO's Memory of the World Register preserves documentary heritage globally (India's Rigveda manuscripts and Ramcharitmanas are listed).
qe: In October 2026, India and France signed a bilateral MoU focused on which cultural heritage domain?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में राष्ट्रीय समुद्री खोज एवं बचाव अभ्यास (SAREX-2026) का 12वाँ संस्करण किस भारतीय समुद्री बल द्वारा आयोजित किया गया?
e: The Indian Coast Guard (ICG), as India's nodal agency for maritime Search and Rescue, conducted the 12th edition of SAREX-2026 in October 2026. Exam Boosters: (1) India's Search and Rescue Region (ISRR) covers ~4.6 million sq. km of the Indian Ocean. (2) ICG functions under the Ministry of Defence.
qe: Which Indian maritime force conducted the 12th edition of the National Maritime Search and Rescue Exercise (SAREX-2026) in October 2026?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के किस शहर को "विश्व की चर्म नगरी" तथा "उत्तर भारत का मैनचेस्टर" कहा जाता है?
e: Kanpur is historically famed as the "Manchester of North India" (for textile mills) and India's premier leather hub. Exam Boosters: (1) Ahmedabad is called the "Manchester of India"; Coimbatore is called the "Manchester of South India". (2) Meerut is famous for sports goods (ODOP); Aligarh for locks.
qe: Which city in Uttar Pradesh is known as the "Leather City of the World" and "Manchester of North India"?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के निम्नलिखित प्रसिद्ध मेलों में से कौन-सा अपने जिले के साथ सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e: Dadri Fair (famous cattle fair held on Kartik Purnima) is organized in Ballia district, NOT Gorakhpur. Gorakhpur is famous for the Khichdi Fair (Makar Sankranti at Gorakhnath Temple). Bateshwar (Agra), Nauchandi (Meerut), and Dewa Sharif (Barabanki) are all correctly matched.
qe: Which of the following famous fairs (मेले) of Uttar Pradesh is NOT correctly matched with its district?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश में गोमती नदी किस जिले में गंगा नदी में आकर मिलती है?
e: The Gomti River originates from Fulhar Jheel (Gomat Taal) in Pilibhit district, flows through Lucknow, Sultanpur, and Jaunpur, and joins the Ganga at Kaithi in Ghazipur district. Exam Boosters: (1) Gomti is a groundwater-fed plain river (not glacier-fed). (2) Betwa joins Yamuna at Hamirpur; Ken joins Yamuna at Banda.
qe: In Uttar Pradesh, the confluence of the Ganga, Yamuna, and mythical Saraswati is at Prayagraj. At which district of UP does the Gomti River join the Ganga?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा जिला चार राज्यों—बिहार, झारखंड, छत्तीसगढ़ और मध्य प्रदेश—के साथ अपनी सीमा साझा करता है?
e: Sonbhadra is the only district in India that borders 4 states (Bihar, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, MP). Exam Boosters: (1) Lalitpur is surrounded on three sides by Madhya Pradesh. (2) Saharanpur borders 3 states (Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Haryana). (3) UP shares its longest state border with Madhya Pradesh and an international border with Nepal (7 districts).
qe: Which district of Uttar Pradesh shares its border with FOUR states—Bihar, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, and Madhya Pradesh?

q: स्वतंत्रता के बाद उत्तर प्रदेश के प्रथम मुख्यमंत्री कौन थे तथा भारत की प्रथम महिला मुख्यमंत्री (जो यूपी से ही थीं) कौन थीं?
o: गोविन्द बल्लभ पन्त व सुचेता कृपलानी
गोविन्द बल्लभ पन्त व विजयलक्ष्मी पंडित
चौधरी चरण सिंह व सुचेता कृपलानी
e: Pandit Govind Ballabh Pant was the first Chief Minister of UP (1950–54; Bharat Ratna 1957), and Sucheta Kripalani was India's first woman Chief Minister (UP, 1963–67). Exam Boosters: (1) Sarojini Naidu was the first woman Governor of an Indian state (United Provinces/UP, 1947–49). (2) Purushottam Das Tandon was the first Speaker of UP Legislative Assembly.
qe: Who was the first Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh after Independence, and who was India's first woman Chief Minister (also from UP)?
oe: Govind Ballabh Pant and Sucheta Kripalani
Govind Ballabh Pant and Vijayalakshmi Pandit
Chaudhary Charan Singh and Sucheta Kripalani

q: गुप्त वंश का संस्थापक कौन था तथा इतिहासकार वी. ए. स्मिथ ने किस गुप्त शासक को "भारत का नेपोलियन" कहा था?
e: Sri Gupta founded the Gupta dynasty (c. 240–280 CE), and Samudragupta (whose conquests are recorded in Harishena's Prayag Prashasti on the Allahabad Pillar) was called the "Napoleon of India" by V. A. Smith. Exam Boosters: (1) Kumaragupta I founded Nalanda University. (2) Chinese pilgrim Fa-Hien visited India during Chandragupta II's (Vikramaditya) reign.
qe: Who was the founder of the Gupta Dynasty, and which Gupta ruler was called the "Napoleon of India" by historian V. A. Smith?

q: 24 सितंबर 1932 को महात्मा गांधी (प्रतिनिधि मदन मोहन मालवीय) और डॉ. बी. आर. अम्बेडकर के बीच "पूना पैक्ट" किस ब्रिटिश घोषणा की प्रतिक्रिया में हुआ था?
e: Following British PM Ramsay MacDonald's Communal Award (August 1932) granting separate electorates to the Depressed Classes, Gandhi undertook a fast unto death in Yerwada Jail, leading to the Poona Pact (reserved seats within joint electorates increased from 71 to 147 in provincial legislatures).
qe: The "Poona Pact" (24 September 1932) was signed between Mahatma Gandhi (represented by Madan Mohan Malaviya) and Dr. B. R. Ambedkar in response to which British announcement?

q: 1916 में "काशी हिंदू विश्वविद्यालय" (BHU) की स्थापना किसने की और दो बार (1909 व 1918) भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के अध्यक्ष रहे?
e: Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya founded BHU in 1916 (incorporating Annie Besant's Central Hindu College, 1898), popularized the slogan "Satyameva Jayate", and was posthumously awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2015.
qe: Who founded the "Banaras Hindu University" (BHU) in 1916 and also presided over the Indian National Congress sessions twice (1909 and 1918)?

q:
सूची-I (समाचार पत्र) को सूची-II (संस्थापक / संपादक) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. मिरात-उल-अखबार — (a) महात्मा गांधी
2. अल-हिलाल — (b) राजा राममोहन राय
3. यंग इंडिया — (c) बाल गंगाधर तिलक
4. केसरी — (d) मौलाना अबुल कलाम आजाद
e: Mirat-ul-Akbar (Persian weekly, 1822): Raja Ram Mohan Roy (1-b); Al-Hilal (Urdu, 1912): Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (2-d); Young India & Harijan: Mahatma Gandhi (3-a); Kesari (Marathi): Bal Gangadhar Tilak (4-c). Exam Boosters: (1) Bengal Gazette (1780, James Augustus Hicky) was India's first newspaper; Udant Martand (1826, Jugal Kishore Shukla, Calcutta) was India's first Hindi newspaper.
qe:
Match List-I (Newspaper / Journal) with List-II (Founder / Editor):
1. Mirat-ul-Akbar (मिरात-उल-अखबार) — (a) Mahatma Gandhi
2. Al-Hilal (अल-हिलाल) — (b) Raja Ram Mohan Roy
3. Young India (यंग इंडिया) — (c) Bal Gangadhar Tilak
4. Kesari (केसरी) — (d) Maulana Abul Kalam Azad

q: दिल्ली सल्तनत के किस सुल्तान ने "बाजार नियंत्रण प्रणाली" तथा "दाग" (घोड़ों को दागना) और "चेहरा" (सैनिकों का हुलिया) प्रथा प्रारंभ की थी?
e: Alauddin Khalji (1296–1316) maintained a large standing army paid in cash and instituted strict price controls managed by 'Diwan-i-Riyasat' and 'Shahna-i-Mandi', alongside Dagh and Chehra. Exam Boosters: (1) Iltutmish introduced silver Tanka, copper Jital, and Iqta system. (2) Balban introduced Sijda and Paibos (Persian court etiquette).
qe: During the Delhi Sultanate, which Sultan introduced the "Market Control Policy" (बाजार नियंत्रण प्रणाली) and the practices of "Dagh" (branding of horses) and "Chehra" (descriptive roll of soldiers)?

q: किसी राज्य में पंचायतों और नगरपालिकाओं के चुनाव कराने के लिए कौन-सा संवैधानिक निकाय उत्तरदायी है?
e: Under Articles 243K (Panchayats) and 243ZA (Municipalities), the State Election Commission conducts all local body elections. The Election Commission of India (Art 324) conducts elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, President, and Vice-President.
qe: Which Constitutional body is responsible for conducting elections to the Panchayats and Municipalities in a State?

q: विद्यालयी शिक्षा की गुणवत्ता, पाठ्यचर्या की रूपरेखा (NCF) और पाठ्यपुस्तकों पर परामर्श हेतु भारत सरकार द्वारा 1961 में किस स्वायत्त संस्था की स्थापना की गई?
o: राष्ट्रीय शैक्षिक अनुसंधान और प्रशिक्षण परिषद
e: NCERT (National Council of Educational Research and Training) was established on 1 September 1961 (headquartered in New Delhi). Exam Boosters: (1) NCTE regulates teacher education (statutory under NCTE Act, 1993). (2) SCERT is the state-level counterpart of NCERT (UP SCERT established in 1981 at Lucknow).
qe: Which educational body was established in 1961 by the Government of India as an autonomous organization to advise on school education quality, curriculum frameworks (NCF), and textbooks?

q: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद उच्च न्यायालयों को रिट जारी करने की शक्ति (संवैधानिक उपचार का अधिकार) प्रदान करता है?
e: Article 226 empowers High Courts to issue the 5 writs not only for enforcing Fundamental Rights but also "for any other purpose" (ordinary legal rights), making HC writ jurisdiction wider in subject scope than SC's Article 32. Exam Boosters: (1) Art 32 is itself a Fundamental Right (SC cannot refuse), whereas Art 226 is discretionary.
qe: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides for the "Right to Constitutional Remedies" in High Courts (empowering High Courts to issue writs)?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 60 के अंतर्गत भारत के राष्ट्रपति को पद की शपथ कौन दिलाता है?
e: Under Article 60, the Chief Justice of India (or in their absence, the senior-most Judge of the Supreme Court) administers the oath to the President to "preserve, protect and defend the Constitution". Exam Boosters: (1) The President submits their resignation to the Vice-President [Art 56(1)(a)]. (2) Governor's oath (Art 159) is administered by the Chief Justice of the concerned High Court.
qe: Under the Indian Constitution, who administers the oath of office to the President of India (Article 60)?

q:
"सूचना का अधिकार (RTI) अधिनियम, 2005" के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: धारा 7(1) के अंतर्गत सामान्यतः 30 दिनों के भीतर तथा किसी व्यक्ति के जीवन या स्वतंत्रता से संबंधित होने पर 48 घंटों के भीतर सूचना प्रदान की जानी चाहिए।
कथन II: केंद्रीय सूचना आयोग (CIC) अनुच्छेद 323A के अंतर्गत स्थापित एक संवैधानिक निकाय है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: न तो I और न ही II
e: Statement I is correct (30 days general; 48 hours for life/liberty). Statement II is incorrect because CIC is a STATUTORY body created under the RTI Act, 2005—not a constitutional body (Article 323A deals with Administrative Tribunals).
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the "Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005":
Statement I: Under Section 7(1), information must ordinarily be provided within 30 days of receipt of the request, and within 48 hours if it concerns the life or liberty of a person.
Statement II: The Central Information Commission (CIC) is a constitutional body established under Article 323A.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: ओडिशा में स्थित भारत की सबसे बड़ी खारे पानी की लैगून झील कौन-सी है, जो प्रवासी पक्षियों के शीतकालीन आवास के रूप में प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Chilika Lake (Odisha) is Asia's largest brackish water lagoon and was India's first Ramsar site (1981, along with Keoladeo National Park). Exam Boosters: (1) Wular Lake (J&K) is India's largest freshwater lake. (2) Loktak Lake (Manipur) hosts Keibul Lamjao, the world's only floating national park. (3) Vembanad (Kerala) is India's longest lake.
qe: Which is the largest brackish water lagoon in India, located in Odisha and famous as a wintering ground for migratory birds?

q: भारत के सभी राज्यों में किस राज्य की तटरेखा (coastline) सबसे लंबी है?
e: Gujarat has the longest coastline among Indian states (~1,214.7 km / ~1,600 km including islands), followed by Andhra Pradesh (~973.7 km) and Tamil Nadu (~906.9 km). Exam Boosters: (1) Nine Indian states and 4 UTs have coastlines (total Indian coastline ≈ 7,516.6 km including islands). (2) Goa has the shortest state coastline.
qe: Which Indian state has the longest coastline among all states of India?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा प्रमुख भारतीय बंदरगाह कच्छ की खाड़ी पर स्थित एक "ज्वारीय बंदरगाह" (Tidal Port) है?
e: Kandla Port (renamed Deendayal Port Authority) in Gujarat is India's premier tidal port, developed after Partition to compensate for the loss of Karachi port. Exam Boosters: (1) Visakhapatnam (AP) is India's deepest landlocked natural port. (2) Jawaharlal Nehru Port (Nhava Sheva, Maharashtra) is India's largest container port.
qe: Which of the following major Indian ports is a "Tidal Port" (ज्वारीय बंदरगाह) located on the Gulf of Kachchh?

q: कल्याणकारी अर्थशास्त्र (Welfare Economics) में योगदान हेतु 1998 में अर्थशास्त्र का नोबेल पुरस्कार किस भारतीय अर्थशास्त्री ने जीता था?
e: Prof. Amartya Sen received the 1998 Nobel Prize in Economics (and Bharat Ratna in 1999) for welfare economics, social choice theory, and famine analysis. Exam Boosters: (1) Abhijit Banerjee (with Esther Duflo & Michael Kremer) won the 2019 Economics Nobel for experimental approaches to alleviating global poverty. (2) Human Development Index (HDI, 1990) was developed by Mahbub ul Haq with inputs from Amartya Sen.
qe: Which Indian economist won the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences in 1998 for his contributions to Welfare Economics?

q: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में "स्टैगफ्लेशन" (मुद्रास्फीतिजनित मंदी) क्या है?
o: तेज आर्थिक वृद्धि के साथ गिरती कीमतें
उच्च मुद्रास्फीति, स्थिर/धीमी आर्थिक वृद्धि और उच्च बेरोजगारी का एक साथ होना
सामान्य मूल्य स्तर में शून्य प्रतिशत से नीचे निरंतर गिरावट
बढ़ते निर्यात के साथ अधिशेष व्यापार संतुलन
e: Stagflation combines economic stagnation (low/negative GDP growth + high unemployment) with persistently high inflation, posing a severe policy dilemma for central banks. Exam Boosters: (1) Deflation = sustained fall in general price level (Option C); Disinflation = slowing down of the rate of inflation.
qe: What is "Stagflation" (मुद्रास्फीतिजनित मंदी) in macroeconomics?
oe: Rapid economic growth accompanied by falling prices
Simultaneous high inflation, stagnant economic growth, and high unemployment
Continuous fall in general price level below zero percent
Rising exports with a surplus balance of trade

q: भारत में केंद्र सरकार का वित्तीय वर्ष (Fiscal Year) कब से कब तक चलता है?
e: India's financial year runs from 1 April to 31 March (adopted in 1867). The RBI also aligned its accounting year from July–June to April–March starting FY 2021–22 on the recommendation of the Bimal Jalan Committee.
qe: In India, the fiscal year (financial year) of the Union Government runs from:

q: विद्युत धारा (Electric Current) और विद्युत प्रतिरोध (Electric Resistance) की SI इकाई क्रमशः क्या है?
e: Electric Current is measured in Ampere (A) and Electric Resistance in Ohm (Ω). Exam Boosters: (1) Potential Difference: Volt (V); Power: Watt (W); Charge: Coulomb (C); Energy/Work: Joule (J); Frequency: Hertz (Hz).
qe: What is the SI unit of Electric Current and Electric Resistance respectively?

q: मानव शरीर की कौन-सी अंतःस्रावी ग्रंथि "इंसुलिन" हार्मोन स्रावित करती है, जिसकी कमी या प्रतिरोध से मधुमेह (Diabetes Mellitus) रोग होता है?
e: Beta cells of the Islets of Langerhans in the Pancreas secrete Insulin (regulates blood glucose by promoting glycogen storage), while Alpha cells secrete Glucagon. Exam Boosters: (1) Pancreas is a "mixed gland" (both exocrine and endocrine). (2) Pituitary gland is called the "Master Gland".
qe: Which endocrine gland in the human body secretes the hormone "Insulin", whose deficiency or resistance leads to Diabetes Mellitus?

q: कंप्यूटर मेमोरी पदानुक्रम में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी एक अस्थिर (VOLATILE) मेमोरी है (बिजली बंद होने पर डेटा नष्ट हो जाता है) और CPU की मुख्य कार्यशील मेमोरी के रूप में कार्य करती है?
e: RAM (SRAM/DRAM) and Cache memory are volatile—data is lost upon power-off. ROM, SSD, and HDD are non-volatile storage media. Exam Boosters: (1) Speed hierarchy (fastest to slowest): CPU Registers → Cache Memory (L1/L2/L3) → RAM → SSD/HDD. (2) 1 Kilobyte (binary) = 1,024 Bytes; 1 Byte = 8 Bits; 1 Nibble = 4 Bits.
qe: In computer memory hierarchy, which of the following is a VOLATILE memory (loses all stored data when power is turned off) and serves as the primary working memory of a CPU?
